5f2c37d304177b6a7fe69f11fbbb1a8c7c4884c6.en:
What is CopyQ?

CopyQ is an extensible clipboard manager with a scriptable user interface.
It stores a history of all copied content and allows access by command line,
Python script or keyboard shortcuts.

For SL5 Aura, CopyQ is the primary tool for voice-to-text results
in the interim storage and administer there.
